from solution import first_Element


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Check 'find the first element occurring k times' example returns 0."""
    assert first_Element([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 6, 1) == 0  # 1+1+1+1+1+1=6, each count 1, first is 0


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Check 'find the first element occurring k times' with one element."""
    assert first_Element([42], 1, 1) == 42  # 1 count = 1, only element is 42


def test_issue_pair_at_start():
    """Check first element occurring 2 times when pair is at start."""
    assert first_Element([3, 3, 1, 4, 5], 5, 2) == 3  # counts: 3->2, 1->1, 4->1, 5->1; 2+1+1+1=5, only 3 has 2


def test_issue_middle_single_qualifier():
    """Check first element occurring 3 times when only middle value qualifies."""
    assert first_Element([10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 20], 6, 3) == 20  # counts: 10->1, 20->3, 30->1, 40->1; 1+3+1+1=6, only 20 has 3


def test_issue_last_single_qualifier():
    """Check first element occurring 2 times when only last value qualifies."""
    assert first_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 4], 5, 2) == 4  # counts: 1->1, 2->1, 3->1, 4->2; 1+1+1+2=5, only 4 has 2


def test_issue_all_unique_k_one():
    """Check first element occurring 1 time when all are unique."""
    assert first_Element([9, 8, 7, 6], 4, 1) == 9  # 1+1+1+1=4, each count 1, first is 9


def test_issue_first_unique_with_later_repeat():
    """Check first element occurring 1 time despite later repeat."""
    assert first_Element([0, 1, 1, 2], 4, 1) == 0  # counts: 0->1, 1->2, 2->1; 1+2+1=4, first with 1 is 0


def test_issue_all_same_k_equals_n():
    """Check first element occurring k times when all same and k equals n."""
    assert first_Element([7, 7, 7, 7], 4, 4) == 7  # 4 counts = 4, 4==4, only 7 has 4


def test_issue_triple_single_qualifier():
    """Check first element occurring 3 times when only one value qualifies."""
    assert first_Element([5, 6, 5, 7, 6, 5], 6, 3) == 5  # counts: 5->3, 6->2, 7->1; 3+2+1=6, only 5 has 3


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Public interface must not mutate the input array."""
    arr = [10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 20]  # 6 elements, n=6, k=3
    snapshot = [10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 20]  # literal copy: 6 elements
    first_Element(arr, 6, 3)  # counts: 10->1, 20->3, 30->1, 40->1
    assert arr == snapshot


def test_contract_result_is_member():
    """Result must be an element occurring k times in the given array."""
    assert first_Element([1, 2, 2, 3], 4, 2) in [1, 2, 2, 3]  # counts: 1->1, 2->2, 3->1; 1+2+1=4, only 2 has 2
